text.tspan: DNS inside a pod: search domains and ndots:5
Names: web (same namespace) · web.shop (any namespace) · db-0.db.shop.svc.cluster.local (one pod, headless).
Slow external lookups? Use a trailing dot (api.stripe.com.), lower ndots in dnsConfig, or NodeLocal DNSCache.
